# Live entries of llama.cpp's `enum ggml_type` (ggml/include/ggml.h), one per
# line, in the form `GGML_TYPE_<NAME> = <discriminant>`. Lines starting with
# `#` are comments.
#
# Source:  https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/blob/37b53fd4545847188fdad29e38ba57875efc8228/ggml/include/ggml.h
# Commit:  37b53fd4545847188fdad29e38ba57875efc8228
#
# tests/gguf_type_snapshot.rs checks that the GGUF parser accepts exactly these
# discriminants, under these names, and refuses everything else.
# .github/workflows/ggml-drift.yml compares this file with upstream master every
# week and fails, naming the difference, when upstream adds or removes a type.
#
# To refresh after teaching the parser a new type, regenerate from the commit
# you checked the layouts against, and update the Commit line above:
#   curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/<commit>/ggml/include/ggml.h | scripts/ggml-types.sh
